universalAnswers.whatHappened: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1 to developers through its API on September 10, and Yelp said it integrated the voice model into Yelp Host and Hatch.
universalAnswers.plainLanguageIdentity: OpenAI calls GPT-Live-1 a front-end voice layer that listens and speaks while a separate backend checks business data and completes tasks.
universalAnswers.evidenceBasis: OpenAI's September 10 release and current developer documentation were reopened on September 11; Yelp's complete company release was captured through its Business Wire syndication mirror.
universalAnswers.evidenceLimits: No reviewed independent evaluation establishes transaction accuracy, and Yelp disclosed no sample size, test method, rollout geography or customer coverage for its early observations.
universalAnswers.readerRelevance: A person may encounter the model while making a restaurant reservation, changing a food order or arranging a service appointment without ever using an API herself.
universalAnswers.affectedPeople: Callers, restaurant staff, service-business staff and developers or operators responsible for the voice system and its connected booking tools.
universalAnswers.changesNow: Developers can use GPT-Live-1 in the API, and Yelp says Yelp Host and Hatch have integrated it as the voice layer for restaurant and service-business calls.
universalAnswers.uncertainty: Which callers and customers receive the integration, and how often a spoken request becomes a correct lasting transaction, remain undisclosed.
universalAnswers.readerAction: After a reservation or repair call, repeat the important details and ask for confirmation of the actual record; ask for a person if the system cannot confirm it.
universalAnswers.betterQuestion: Did the connected booking system record the request correctly, and what evidence measures that outcome rather than only how natural the voice sounded?

model-tool-release.productRange: GPT-Live-1 is the front-end voice layer for applications; a separate backend model, business data and tools perform deeper reasoning and actions.
model-tool-release.newCapabilities: OpenAI says it listens and speaks at the same time and is designed to handle pauses, interruptions, changing directions and background noise more naturally.
model-tool-release.bestFitTasks: Phone conversations that change midway, including reservations, food orders, customer support and service appointments.
model-tool-release.notFor: It does not itself prove that a reservation or appointment was recorded, and it may be unnecessary for a simple menu lookup or email.
model-tool-release.nearestAlternatives: A traditional chained voice system passes speech through separate listening, reasoning and speaking stages; a person can still handle the call directly.
model-tool-release.availability: OpenAI says the model is available to developers in the API; Yelp says it is integrated into Yelp Host and Hatch but gives no caller, location or customer rollout list.
model-tool-release.freePaidBoundary: The release is an API product for developers, not a new setting every caller or ChatGPT account receives, and the caller's price is not established by the API rate.
model-tool-release.costBoundary: OpenAI lists $0.05 per minute for the front-end voice layer, with backend models and tools billed separately.
model-tool-release.limitations: Yelp's improved call-handling observations lack a disclosed sample, method and independent assessment; rollout and transaction accuracy remain unknown.
model-tool-release.technicalExampleProportionality: One changed restaurant reservation shows why smoother interruption handling and a confirmed booking are separate system results.
model-tool-release.vendorEvidenceBoundary: OpenAI and Yelp establish their release, architecture and adoption claims; no reviewed source independently establishes the claimed downstream improvement.

translation.newsVersionExact: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1 to developers through its API on September 10.
translation.actualMeaningExact: This is where someone who never opens an API may encounter the release: while making a reservation, changing a food order or arranging an appointment by phone.
translation.mechanismExact: A separate backend system still checks business information, applies rules and uses tools.
translation.familiarExampleExact: Imagine changing a reservation from four people to five while the voice is still replying.

learningConnections.learningPayoff: Working with AI 101 teaches how to check a confident output against the source or record that determines whether it is correct.
